text:
anya: Quick pingI want to consolidate a few loose threads: can we agree on a single compact manifest for routing + auth that works across hosted, dedicated, and private? Keep it intentionally tiny.

felix: Sounds good. Minimal should be tenant_hash, affinity_hint, secret_locator (opaque), manifest_v, caps_allowed. No inline key material unless explicitly allowed for private.

olivia: Agreed but add resolve_mode (eager|lazy|external) and a small ttl. Also a migration_marker + grace_seconds so caches can be warmed during relocation.

anya: Proposed fail classes: RESOLVE_TEMP (retry), RESOLVE_PERM (fallback/abort), POLICY_DENIED (audit + abort). We should encode these so adapters behave deterministically.

felix: For hosted/dedicated/private differences: hosted may resolve kms:// URIs and cache; dedicated only if customer allowlist; private must never let host resolve host-kms URIsinstead get local:// or customer-token://. Make that a hard rule.

olivia: Telemetry: include telemetry_tag = HMAC(tenant_id, rotation_key) so traces are correlation-safe. Also manifest should be signed and include manifest_id for debug traces.

anya: Example compact payload in thread for clarity:
```json
{"tenant_hash":"th-01","affinity_hint":"zone-x","secret_locator":"kms://r/aaab","resolve_mode":"lazy","ttl":300,"manifest_v":"2","caps_allowed":["resolve_kms","cache_creds"],"migration_marker":null}
```

felix: Implementation notes: negotiation step: control plane issues manifest_v + caps_allowed; adapter responds with caps_supported and resolve_intent. If manifest_v unsupported, adapter replies MANIFEST_UNSUPPORTED and control plane falls back to older route.

olivia: Also require caps_hash to avoid tampering; mismatch = MANIFEST_HASH_MISMATCH and adapter aborts.

infra-bot: preflight: manifest-schema-check queued, migration-sim tests running.

anya: Action items: Felix draft caps matrix + RBAC rules, Olivia draft private-mode MUST NOT doc for host KMS resolution, I'll assemble RFC with compact manifest spec and error mapping. Will open draft in 48h unless objections. :thumbsup:

felix: :thumbsup:

olivia: +1
